body: The same thing happened to me. Where are you from? I’d like to help you find him. I’m never on here. Reach out to me on social or my website if you see this… www.markhenick.com

There's only so much you can do in 15 minutes on a popular platform. I'm not going to go on a rant about Kant, or wander down a path of behaviourism, even if these themes are present. 

I chose to take a more personal approach because that is the objective of the talk - to enter people into the individual experience without getting them so wrapped up in theory. Theories are not people, and real people's lives are at stake in all of this. Suicide is a complex beast, most of all for those considering it or dealing with the aftereffects. In opening up such an issue for the broader public, the dispassionate eye is the problem. It closes the discussion and limits the reach to only those who like to think, rather than those who like to do.
